reports.title: Tyra Biosciences Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results and Recent Highlights

desk.headline: Net loss widens to $51.1m as trial spending rises; $400m raise lifts cash to $700.5m, runway through 2030
results: Clinical-stage company with no product revenue; net loss widened to $51.1m ($0.74 a share) from $29.9m ($0.50).
R&D spending rose to $43.1m from $25.5m, mainly for its three Phase 2 trials of oral dabogratinib; G&A rose to $11.7m from $7.5m.
Raised about $400m gross in a September share and pre-funded warrant offering led by RA Capital; cash and securities reached $700.5m.
Early bladder-cancer (SURF302) data at 60 mg daily: 79% response rate and 64% complete response in 14 patients, with no Grade 3 drug-related side effects.
First upper-tract patient (SURF303) had a complete response at three months; the achondroplasia trial opened a sixth dose level.

guidance.summary: No financial forecast, as usual for a clinical-stage biotech. The company expects its cash to fund operations through 2030 and lists three trial milestones for 2027.

items.metric: Phase 3 adjuvant IR NMIBC study start; more Phase 2 data

watch: Feedback from regulators on the design of the planned Phase 3 bladder-cancer study.
Results from the new 70 mg cohort in SURF302 and further SURF303 enrolment.
Quarterly cash burn against the through-2030 runway as R&D keeps rising.
